title: context_pack — a box-built code map of one queued issue (more-local-inference 08)
description: What a local model found in the checkout at main for one issue: the files, symbols, tests and commands the work will touch. `gate` drops every file and test whose path is not in the checkout, renders the rest as Markdown, and fails a pack over 8,000 characters. `post` publishes it as the issue's context-pack marker comment, which backlog's and ralph's `claim` copy into background.md for decompose and plan. _io is stamped by the server and is not part of this schema.

files.description: The files the work will read or change, most important first.

path.description: Repository-relative path, exactly as in the checkout.

lines.description: The line range that matters, as `40-95`.

why.description: One line: what is there and why the work needs it.

symbols.description: The functions, classes, types or config keys the work will change or call.

callers.description: path:line of up to three callers that a change would affect.

tests.description: The test files that cover the code above, or where a new test belongs.

commands.description: The commands that run those tests and checks, as the repository runs them.

task_map.description: Only for an issue big enough to split: a draft of the steps, one line each, in order.

notes.description: Traps a planner would hit: a generated file, a second copy of the logic, a test that needs a service.
